title: chlorocyperus aureus
intro: Chlorocyperus aureus, commonly known as the Golden Sedge, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chlorocyperus aureus include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and soothe digestive problems. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
